label: The mode-of-being pair is equivalent to: a total cause of being causes every actual perfection
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Over the shared frame and for any total-cause relation: there is a reading ModeOfBeing on which every perfection a thing has in act is a mode of its being (791fa216) and a total cause of a thing's being causes each of its modes of being (2f6b9eff), exactly when a total cause of a thing's being causes each perfection that thing has in act. Since 791fa216's ModeOfBeing is a primitive that, in every registered consumer, occurs only in 791fa216 and one other premise, the pair says no more than the composite; its warrant is whatever fixes the meaning of 'mode of being'. It asserts neither premise.
